root_cause: uvicorn waits for open streaming responses before lifespan shutdown and had no --timeout-graceful-shutdown, so docker SIGKILLed the BFF after 30s.
fix: events/router.py: process-wide SSE shutdown signal; every SSE generator (_stream_events, liveness stream) is wrapped in _end_on_shutdown, which closes the source (unsubscribes) when shutdown fires
core/lifespan.py: startup chains a SIGTERM/SIGINT hook calling begin_sse_shutdown (uvicorn waits for streams before lifespan shutdown, so the hook must be a signal)

measurements.method: local uvicorn on a minimal app using the real SSE generators and shutdown hooks, one open curl SSE client, SIGTERM
